items.label: Keel Infrastructure press release: Keel Infrastructure Supports Governor Shapiro's GRID (08-20-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Keel said permitting at its Panther Creek and Sharon (Pennsylvania) data center sites
items.reason: Not an important release under skill section 2: a policy endorsement of a state executive order whose body is advocacy / CSR (energy affordability, community engagement, local hiring, environmental stewardship). Its only operating line, permitting 'on schedule' and unaffected by the order, gives no capacity, date or figure and does not change the schedule the Q2 FY2026 call already set (Panther Creek and Sharon RFS end of 2027); the cost-allocation and closed-loop-cooling lines are listed as GRID-principle compliance, not new operating facts.
items.evidence: Panther Creek and Sharon permitting continue to proceed on schedule and are unaffected by Executive Order 2026-05
